query: mutation UpdateTemplateQuery($templateId: ID!, $newQuery: String!, $updateVariables: JSON) { updateTemplateQuery(templateId: $templateId, newQuery: $newQuery, updateVariables: $updateVariables) { success previousQuery template { id identifier name } errors { message } } }

variables.newQuery: query ListTablesWithPagination($pagination: PaginationInput, $filter: String, $sortBy: String = "createdAt", $sortOrder: String = "DESC", $minNodeCount: Int, $maxNodeCount: Int) { tables(pagination: $pagination, filter: $filter, sortBy: $sortBy, sortOrder: $sortOrder, minNodeCount: $minNodeCount, maxNodeCount: $maxNodeCount) { nodes { id identifier name description nodeCount attributeCount createdAt updatedAt } totalCount hasNextPage hasPreviousPage } }
